title: Throat of the Hollow Star
description: A screaming formant voice built from a hard-driven sawtooth: vowels morph through a-e-i-o-u while a fast tremolo gate chops it into a stuttering alien wail. Over 16 cycles the band-pass sweep, FM grit and vibrato depth all swell so the scream rises from a hollow moan to a shredding shriek before resetting.
code:
setcpm(124/4)
stack(
  note("<g3 [g3 bb3] c4 <bb3 d4>>/2").s("sawtooth")
    .vowel("<a e i o u e>/3")
    .fm(sine.slow(24).range(1, 7)).fmh("<1 1.5 2 0.5>/8")
    .vib("<7 11 13>/8").vibmod(sine.slow(13).range(0.3, 2.2))
    .bpf(sine.slow(16).range(500, 3600)).resonance(sine.slow(11).range(10, 20))
    .shape(saw.slow(16).range(0.2, 0.6)).crush("<16 10 7>/16")
    .tremolosync("<4 8 6 12>/4").tremolodepth(sine.slow(7).range(0.4, 0.95))
    .pan(sine.slow(9).range(0.15, 0.85))
    .sometimesBy(0.18, x => x.speed(-1))
    .attack(0.01).decay(0.18).sustain(0.7).release(0.08)
    .delay("0.4:0.375:0.6").room(0.7).gain(0.7)
)
